[SWS_DM_01475] DM shall allow only one lock per
SOVD
entity
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04264
⌈
DM shall not allow a SOVD client to acquire a lock on the SOVD entity (or SOVD
sub entity) if another SOVD client has locked the same SOVD entity for accessing or
operating on the SOVD entity resource and return error code.
⌋
